subject: general
question: Who among the following addressed the Indian National congress as its President in 1887?
solution:
The correct answer is __Badruddin Tyabji.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the British Raj, Badruddin Tyabji (10 October 1844 – 19 August 1906) was an Indian lawyer, activist, and politician.
 
• The first Indian to work as a barrister in the High Court of Bombay was Tyabji.
 
• In 1887, he held the position of Indian National Congress' third president.
 
• He served as the first Muslim president of the Indian National Congress and was one of its founding members.
 
• In 1874, he established the Anjuman-i-Islam College in Bombay.
 
• Tyabji also campaigned to undermine the zenana system and for the freedom of women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gopal Krishna Gokhale (9 May 1866 – 19 February 1915):

 
 
• He was a social reformer and "moderate" political figure in India during the struggle for independence.
 
• Gokhale was the founder of the Servants of India Society.
 
• He was a prominent member of the Indian National Congress.
 
 
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji (4 September 1825 – 30 June 1917):
 
 
• He was an author, businessman, scholar, and political figure in India.
 
• He presided over the Indian National Congress from 1886 to 1887, 1893 to 1894, and 1906 to 1907 as its second, ninth, and 22nd president.
 
 
 
• Surendranath Banerjee (10 November 1848 – 6 August 1925):
 
 
• He led the Indian nationalist movement under British rule.
 
• He established the Indian National Association, a nationalist group.
 
• He was one of the Indian National Congress' founding members. 
 
 
 
• Womesh Chandra Bonerjee **(****29 December 1844-21 July 1906)**
 
 
• ​Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee was born on 29 December 1844 in **Calcutta**.
 
• In **1883 **he defended** Surendranath Banerjee **in the famous Contempt of Court Case against him in the** Calcutta High Court**.
 
• He presided over the **first **session of the Indian National Congress held at **Bombay **in **1885**.
